$comment: Single source of truth for every visual decision. PROPOSAL built from the client's brand pack (2026-11-23). Not approved; fonts, colours and logo usage are provisional. Neutral test system archived at brand/archive/design-system-0.1.0-neutral.json.
statusNote: LifeLink brand PROPOSAL for client review. Colour codes sampled from a screenshot, fonts awaiting licence confirmation, logo artwork not supplied. Every render carries a watermark until status is APPROVED.

palette.$comment: Brand palette: exact codes supplied by the client on 2026-11-24 (brand/intake/uploads-2026-11-24/colour-codes.webp).

derived.$comment: Tints/shades DERIVED from the palette for depth and legibility. Not client colours; listed for approval.
derived.$illustration: skyTint/hillFar/hillMid: tints between royal and sky for paper-cut landscape depth (derived, need approval)

colors.$comment: Semantic roles used by components. Values reference palette/derived above.

rules: Wordmark and short accent words/phrases only (≤ 4 words)
Never for body copy, numbers in diagrams or anything under 56 px at 1080p
Avoid words starting with capital I in script (the glyph reads as J)
No numerals in script; numbers use the text face
Single weight: hierarchy comes from size, colour, case and tracking
Font has very wide default word spaces: apply wordSpacing token

wordSpacing.$note: Body font's space glyph is 0.715 em (normal ≈ 0.27 em); corrected optically.

fontFiles.$note: Display-time metric override: the font declares 1.557 em line metrics but its glyphs use ~1.14 em (OS/2 win metrics). File unchanged.

motion.$comment: Motion language: 'paper and ink'. Elements move like heavy stationery (slide, settle, never bounce); words appear like ink (mask wipes). No zooms, spins, particles or elastic easing.

easing.$note: enter = soft start, long settle (was [0.22,1,0.36,1], which started at full speed and read as choppy: client feedback 2026-11-23)

rules: Maximum travel for an entering element: ~160 px at 1080p, with ease-in-out and a fade. Long, fast slides judder at 30 fps.
No element should go from rest to full speed in one frame: every move accelerates and decelerates.
Avoid rotating flat cards/text during motion (edge shimmer).

logo.$comment: Client-supplied logo artwork 2026-11-24 (raster PNG). The crescent/heart mark is the logo icon: use only as part of the logo, never as a decorative motif.
logo.artworkColour: #490805 (as exported in the PNGs; palette oxblood is #500000)
logo.vector: not yet supplied (optional; raster is sufficient up to its pixel size)

motifs.twoPaths: Two lines (two people) that travel separately and join into one two-tone line: each remains whole. Used once per lesson at most, structurally (e.g. a process that ends in an introduction). PROPOSED.
motifs.blindEmboss: Wordmark or type pressed into card stock, revealed by a raking light. PROPOSED.
rejected: Two-ring motif (v1.0.0-proposal.1): read as wedding bands in independent review; removed before client presentation
motifs.paperCut: Layered cut-paper illustrations in palette colours with soft shadows; ink lines that draw themselves. PROPOSED (client asked for more pictorial content, 2026-11-23).

rules: No hearts, wedding rings or ring-like pairs, romantic clichés
No generic Islamic geometric patterns or crescent motifs
No people until imagery rules are confirmed
Do not redraw or imitate the logo mark (solid disc with offset counter-form)
Warm, sincere, never preachy or flirtatious
Welcoming across cultures and levels of practice
